the interdependence between banking systems and sovereigns is a key feature of the eurozone.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the euro area is not immune to a vicious cycle between banks and sovereigns.
the euro area needs a banking union, and that this should include a European deposit insurance and resolution mechanism.

a stronger banking union, in particular the introduction of a single resolution mechanism, could be the most effective way of breaking the vicious bank-sovereign loop and of improving the resilience of the euro area financial system to shocks.
